slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do the three machines operate in series, so that each product must be processed on Machine 1, then Machine 2, then Machine 3 in that fixed machine order?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether products follow a fixed machine sequence 1→2→3, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the "total processing cycle" you want to minimize the time from the start of the first operation until the last product finishes on Machine 3 (i.e., the makespan)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for clarification of 'total processing cycle' and whether it means makespan, fully covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; remaining questions addressed minor assumptions and no P0/P1 slots were unresolved.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved both P0 hidden slots—the fixed machine sequence and the makespan objective—before stopping, and also clarified several secondary scheduling assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
